name: xTool M1
notes: Diode laser with a blade cutter (blade area 365 x 300). xTool also sold a 5 W version; the extension reads the power from the machine and only names 10 W.
source: Image modes: xTool Studio's image mode list, values read from projects saved by xTool Studio for the M2 (2026-11-27); assumed the same for this machine. xTool Studio 1.9.11 device extension MLM (exts/M1), read 2026-11-26. Work area from processingArea (LASER_PLANE 385 x 300; the canvas is 400 x 300); module from defaultPower 10. That it is a blue diode is not stated in the extension. Which operations each module can do is an assumption.
